segments.title: Daily Closing Reflection
segments.heading: Meaning in Daily Craft
segments.body: Closing reflection on Meaning in Daily Craft: Quiet consistency in clinical and creative work compounds over years in ways rarely visible in a single day. Thank you for listening to Slayer. Have a grounded day ahead.
